invariant: A Windows source path (C:\Users\dev\repo) validates and resolves; a different Windows path is rejected.
notes: e60d66aa77 fix; platform path handling.

test (describe > name): OpenCode server provider trust boundary > rejects upstream session id %j before any request leaves
invariant: An upstreamSessionId that could escape its URL segment (., .., slashes, encoded traversal, whitespace, NUL, empty, >256 chars) is rejected with invalid_binding and zero requests sent.
notes: test.each over 14 hostile ids; P-42 fix (67b8192c67).

test (describe > name): OpenCode server provider trust boundary > refuses a cleartext base URL that is not this machine's own loopback
invariant: validateConfig rejects http:// base URLs except true loopback (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]); lookalike hosts are rejected.
notes: P-42 fix (e4a45fa1ff).

test (describe > name): OpenCode server provider trust boundary > refuses configured header %s, which belongs to the request this adapter builds
invariant: trustedHeaders and tenant.header may not override hop-by-hop or content headers (Accept, Content-Type, Connection, Keep-Alive, TE, Trailer, Transfer-Encoding, Upgrade).
notes: test.each over 8 reserved names.

test (describe > name): OpenCode server provider trust boundary > rejects header configuration that is not a valid HTTP header at decode or resolve
invariant: CRLF in header names/values/resolved secrets is rejected and no request leaves.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > probes compatibility before mutation and maps Basic plus trusted headers to the target workspace
invariant: createSession calls /global/health before POST /session, maps basic auth, trusted and tenant headers, and sends X-OpenCode-Directory.
notes: Asserts upstream request order and headers, which neither corpus records.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > never mutates an incompatible server and bounds and redacts its error
invariant: A failed health probe yields compatibility_probe_failed with the body bounded and credential material redacted, and no mutating request is sent.
notes: P-42 fix; asserts zero mutations after a failed probe.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > applies a bounded compatibility request deadline
invariant: A health probe slower than requestMs fails with deadline_exceeded.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > enforces the mapped directory and upstream session and reconciles a no-ID disconnect from snapshots
invariant: Only envelopes for the mapped directory and bound session drive the turn; a disconnect mid-turn reconciles from snapshots (latest text wins) and the SSE reconnect sends no Last-Event-ID.
notes: H17 covers a plain turn; this asserts filtering of foreign directory/session frames and the resync path.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > rejects a session-bearing global event that omits its workspace directory
invariant: A session-scoped event with no directory envelope fails the turn with invalid_event.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > returns a typed gap instead of stale success when authoritative reconciliation cannot scope status
invariant: When /session/status cannot scope this session, the turn fails with reconciliation_gap rather than reporting success.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > fails unsupported interactive events instead of yielding a request that cannot be answered
invariant: A permission.asked event aborts the upstream session once and fails the turn with unsupported_interaction.
notes: The defect-registered behavior: H-7 routes permission.asked through the broker and OpenCode's reply endpoints (or OpenCode via ACP). The abort-once-on-failure discipline may deserve a focused test if other interactive events stay unsupported.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > a remote abort returning HTTP %s establishes nothing about the turn
invariant: cancelTurn maps abort results: 500→http_error, 404→owner_unavailable with unknown/unknown, 200→unknown/unknown; a failed abort never kills the caller's view of a still-running turn, an accepted one ends it.
notes: test.each over 500/404/200; the plan's remote-harness rule: protocol cancel only, never proven. Asserts the stream still delivers after a failed abort.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > rejects cross-workspace bindings and does not fabricate session configuration
invariant: getSession rejects wrong directory, foreign connectionId and a retired scope; getSessionConfig/updateSessionConfig return unsupported_operation rather than inventing config.
notes: a2178e8268 fix territory (explicit binding ownership).

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > refuses a stored message whose nested wire values the contract does not describe
invariant: getMessages rejects upstream messages carrying contract-invalid parts (javascript: url, malformed attachments) with invalid_response.
notes: The adapter must not pass through parts the contract rejects.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > truthfully advertises only bound operations
invariant: readHarnessCapabilities returns exactly the implemented surface (abort/reconnect/todos true, permissions/questions/configOptions/goals false, instructionChannel none) and no listSessions/discoverSessions members exist.
notes: The capabilities payload is wire data the app renders; 327508fca1 added goals:false. If decision 2 takes ACP, the row is OBSOLETE.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > passes a dotted-but-segment-safe upstream id through unchanged
invariant: An upstream id like ses_a.b-c~d reaches /session/{id} unchanged.
notes: Positive half of the segment-safety rule.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > refuses to adopt an upstream session id that cannot stay inside its URL segment
invariant: createSession rejects a server-returned id of ".." with invalid_response.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > scopes credentialed requests to the configured base URL path
invariant: Credentials are sent only under the configured base URL path (/api/…), not to sibling paths.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > redacts raw and encoded credential material from error diagnostics
invariant: An upstream error body echoing the secret (raw or URL-encoded) surfaces as http_error with [REDACTED], never the secret.
notes: P-42 fix.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > redacts credentials from reconciled tool error diagnostics
invariant: A reconciled tool-error part has the secret redacted in the emitted event.
notes: P-42 fix; redaction inside the event path.

test (describe > name): OpenCodeServerAdapter real HTTP/SSE protocol > redacts credentials a tool echoed back through its output
invariant: Secrets embedded in tool output (string or structured stdout/frames) are redacted in emitted tool-output events.
notes: P-42 fix.

test (describe > name): package boundary > contains no process, bundled-binary, generated SDK, proxy, or adoption path
invariant: The adapter package's source never spawns processes, never imports the OpenCode SDK client, and has no proxy/session-adoption paths.
notes: Re-expressed by the harness package's transport-boundary ratchet; OBSOLETE if decision 2 drops opencode-http.

test (describe > name): package boundary > declares only Claxedo contract/runtime dependencies
invariant: package.json dependencies are exactly the four @claxedo packages.
notes: The transport-boundary ratchet (vendor SDK only in its own transport) covers this.

test (describe > name): package boundary > exports only the provider composition boundary
invariant: The package exports exactly OPENCODE_SERVER_CONNECTION_PROVIDER_KEY and createOpenCodeServerConnectionProvider.
notes: Export-surface check; transports in packages/harness export through the registry instead.

test (describe > name): reconciles only this prompt's answer and finishes when OpenCode removes idle status
invariant: executeTurn prompts once with a minted sortable userMessageId, reconciles only the reply to that prompt (older assistant messages ignored) and finishes when the session leaves busy status.
notes: The core OpenCode turn; assert the minted userMessageId and that only this prompt's answer is taken. If decision 2 takes ACP: OBSOLETE(opencode-http transport).

test (describe > name): filters old live message events and projects wire deltas and named tools through the canonical UI projector
invariant: Live events for stale messages are dropped; deltas are applied once; a named tool part projects to a completed message.part.updated frame with its input/output/metadata.
notes: The projected presentation frames are the assertion; TRANSLATOR-CORPUS covers the leaf-event mapping half.

test (describe > name): recovers a new assistant step whose message event was missed before the idle notification
invariant: When the SSE stream ends before a second step's events arrive, snapshot reconciliation still emits both steps' text then finish.
notes: Reconciliation must complete a turn from snapshots alone.

test (describe > name): reconciles authoritative text with %s deltas around SSE reconnect
invariant: After a reconnect, authoritative snapshot text reconciles with live deltas whether a delta was missed or overlapped, producing the full text once then finish.
notes: test.each over missing/overlapping gap kinds.

test (describe > name): observes completion despite a missed idle event during %s
invariant: A turn completes via status snapshots even when the idle event is lost to a reconnect, to heartbeat-only silence, or interleaved with busy heartbeats and live deltas.
notes: test.each over reconnect/heartbeats/busy heartbeats; asserts a busy poll does not force snapshot-only recovery mid-turn.

test (describe > name): does not report success with %s
invariant: Unfinished answers, only-old answers, missing session, malformed or busy/retry statuses, a newer unfinished step and tool-calls-pending all end in reconciliation_gap, never finish.
notes: test.each over 8 unverifiable endings; the safety property is "never stale success".

test (describe > name): reconciles an authoritative current-turn error without calling it success
invariant: A completed upstream answer carrying an error yields a terminal error event and no finish.
notes: Error-vs-success is decided at reconciliation, not translation.

test (describe > name): orders prompts between remote messages with %d milliseconds of clock skew
invariant: Minted userMessageIds sort strictly between the previous remote message and the new answer even under ±1h of remote clock skew (UUIDv7-style id ordering).
notes: test.each over ±3600000ms.

test (describe > name): repeated failed turns stay ordered without growing their message IDs
invariant: Successive failed turns mint strictly increasing userMessageIds of constant length that still precede later remote messages.

test (describe > name): rejects reconciliation messages from another upstream session
invariant: A snapshot message whose sessionID is not the bound session's is rejected with invalid_response.

test (describe > name): rejects reconciliation parts attached to another message
invariant: Snapshot parts whose messageID belongs to a different message are rejected with invalid_response.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > emits text once across snapshot, delta and final snapshot
invariant: OpenCode message.part.updated/delta events for a text part emit each text piece exactly once across snapshot→delta→final-snapshot sequences.
notes: Input kind: OpenCode server leaf events (message.part.updated, message.part.delta). Generated by the for-loop over text/reasoning — this is the text case.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > emits reasoning once across snapshot, delta and final snapshot
invariant: Same dedup for reasoning parts, emitted as thinking-delta.
notes: Second generated case of the for-loop.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > projects tool identity, input, metadata and completion without duplicate replay
invariant: A tool part's pending→running→completed lifecycle emits tool-start/tool-status/tool-input/tool-status/tool-output exactly once and projects to the completed part frame.
notes: Input: OpenCode tool part snapshots; also asserts the projected frame — wire corpus covers that half.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > a completed tool first seen during reconciliation retains its full lifecycle
invariant: A tool part first seen already-errored still emits start, input and error in order.
notes: Input: single errored tool snapshot.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > reports a gap instead of appending a rewritten snapshot
invariant: A part whose snapshot text diverges from previously emitted deltas throws reconciliation_gap rather than emitting the rewrite.
notes: Corpus case must record the thrown gap, not just emitted events.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > does not guess whether an orphan delta is text or reasoning
invariant: A delta for a part never snapshotted throws reconciliation_gap instead of guessing its kind.

test (describe > name): OpenCode part translation > projects the upstream retry state as canonical recovery
invariant: session.status retry maps to the canonical session-status recovering event.
notes: Input: session.status retry leaf event.
